extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial investigators, protocol/report authors, journal editors, and peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: A catalogue of SPIRIT and CONSORT reporting extensions tailored to specific trial designs, data types, populations, and interventions, intended to improve completeness and transparency of trial protocols and reports. Includes links to extension checklists, statements, explanations/elaborations, and supplementary materials where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of SPIRIT and CONSORT extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: The main SPIRIT and CONSORT Statements are based on the 'standard' two-group parallel design; many variations (design, interventions, data) require modified guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensions adapt the main statements for different trial designs (e.g., cluster), interventions (e.g., non-pharmacological), and data types (e.g., harms). The site presents available extensions (not exhaustive) and invites those developing new extensions to review the extension policy and register interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing a new SPIRIT/CONSORT extension (extension policy & registration)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are interested in developing a new SPIRIT or CONSORT extension please review our extension policy. You can register your interest by completing this short registration form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and procedural requirements for proposing a new extension are provided via the extension policy and a registration mechanism (links on the page). Use these resources before starting extension development.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-C (Children & adolescents)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT-C Children & adolescents: Statement / Explanation & elaboration / Additional materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published based on SPIRIT 2025; includes a statement, explanation & elaboration, and additional materials to address reporting needs specific to pediatric populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-C (Children & adolescents)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT-C Children & adolescents: Statement / Explanation & elaboration / Additional materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published based on CONSORT 2025; provides tailored reporting guidance, explanatory material, and supplemental resources for trials involving children and adolescents.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Early-phase dose-finding trials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extension to SPIRIT 2013 addressing protocol/reporting items specific to dose-finding (early-phase) trial designs; resources include a downloadable checklist and official statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Factorial trials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension covering protocol reporting considerations specific to factorial trial designs; includes an official statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — N-of-1 trials
rubrics_metrics.description: N-of-1 trials: Checklist (Word) / Explanation and elaboration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension with a checklist and explanation/elaboration to guide reporting of single-patient (N-of-1) trial protocols and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Outcomes (data)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension focused on how outcomes should be defined and reported in protocols; includes a statement with guidance on outcome specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Pathology (data)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension with recommendations for reporting pathology-related outcomes or assessments in trial protocols/reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Patient-reported outcomes (data)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension providing guidance on planning and reporting patient-reported outcome measures in trial protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Surrogate outcomes (data)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension addressing definition, justification, and reporting of surrogate endpoints in trial protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT — Artificial intelligence (interventions)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2013 extension offering a checklist and statement for reporting trials involving artificial intelligence interventions, covering AI-specific design and implementation considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Adaptive designs (design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adaptive designs: Abstract checklist (Word) / Main checklist (Word) / Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2010 extension for reporting adaptive trial designs; provides separate abstract and main checklists plus an explanatory statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Cluster trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2010 extension with a checklist and statement addressing issues unique to cluster-randomized trials (e.g., clustering, unit of analysis, sample size calculation adjustments).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Cluster crossover trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension providing reporting guidance tailored to cluster crossover trial designs; includes an official statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Crossover trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2010 extension focused on reporting crossover trial-specific items (e.g., period effects, carryover); includes a statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Early-phase dose-finding trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension for reporting early-phase dose-finding randomized trials, providing a checklist and statement for design- and reporting-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Factorial trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2010 extension with guidance on reporting factorial trial designs; includes an official statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Multi-arm trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension addressing reporting considerations for trials with more than two arms; includes a statement covering comparative analyses and multiplicity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Non-inferiority/equivalence trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension providing checklist and statement for reporting non-inferiority or equivalence trial designs, including margin justification and analysis populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — N-of-1 trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.description: N-of-1 trials: Checklist (Word) / Statement / Explanation and elaboration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2010 extension with checklist, statement, and explanation/elaboration for reporting N-of-1 randomized trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Pilot and feasibility trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pilot and feasibility trials: Abstract checklist (Word) / Main checklist (Word) / Flow diagram (Word) / Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension for reporting pilot/feasibility randomized trials providing tailored abstract and main checklists, flow diagram templates, and a statement addressing objectives and interpretation appropriate for pilot studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Pragmatic trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension guiding reporting of pragmatic trial designs emphasizing real-world applicability and context; includes checklist and statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Stepped-wedge cluster trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension with a PDF checklist and statement focused on stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial reporting, including timing and transition reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Trials using cohort/routine data (design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Trials using cohort/routine data: Checklist (.pdf) / Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension addressing trials that use existing cohorts or routine data sources; includes a PDF checklist and statement on data provenance, linkage, and biases.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Within-person trials (design)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within-person trials: Checklist (Word) / Flow diagram (Word) / Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension for within-person randomized designs (e.g., split-body studies) including checklist, flow diagram, and statement on analysis and reporting considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Abstracts (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstracts: Checklist (Word) / Statement / Explanation and elaboration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension providing a structured abstract checklist and explanatory guidance to improve completeness of trial abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Equity (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension focused on reporting equity-relevant aspects (e.g., participant characteristics, subgroup analyses) with checklist, flow diagram, and statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Harms (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension providing recommendations for reporting harms/adverse events in trial reports to improve transparency and completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Outcomes (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension offering guidance on defining, measuring, and reporting outcomes in trial reports; includes a statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Patient-reported outcomes (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension giving recommendations for reporting trials that include patient-reported outcome measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Surrogate outcomes (data/reporting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension addressing reporting requirements for surrogate endpoints, including justification and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Non-pharmacological interventions (interventions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-pharmacological interventions: Abstract checklist (Word) / Main checklist (Word) / Flow diagram (Word) / Statement / Explanation and elaboration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive extension for reporting non-pharmacological interventions (e.g., behavioral, surgical) including tailored abstract and main checklists, flow diagrams, a statement, and explanation/elaboration materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT — Social and psychological interventions (interventions)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension providing reporting guidance specific to social and psychological intervention trials; includes an official statement.
